title: Prepare your PC. Prove the result. Restore with control.
summary: Your PC can deliver a more stable experience. Analyze the hardware, apply safe optimizations, and enter the game with fewer background processes, fewer interruptions, and complete control to undo changes.
body: Liiiraa Boost analyzes the machine, prepares a clear plan, measures before and after, and keeps a safe path to undo changes.

metadata.title: Liiiraa Boost | Evidence-led performance and control
metadata.description: Analyze, optimize, and compare your gaming PC with safe, explainable, and reversible adjustments.

warnings: Compatibility and results depend on hardware, Windows version, the game, and measurement quality.
Download availability and compatibility are verified before installation.
actionableClaims: Start free with Essential Mode, with no card or trial.
Unlock Competitive Mode when you want per-game calibration and automation.

acquisition.trustLine: Start free · Windows 10 and 11 · Reversible changes

conversionJourney.label: Before you optimize
conversionJourney.title: Your game should not compete with everything Windows happens to be running.
conversionJourney.body: Background processes, startup weight, power behavior, and generic settings can compete with the match. Liiiraa Boost identifies what deserves attention before changing anything.

conversionJourney.label: How it works
conversionJourney.title: Analyze. Optimize. Prove.
conversionJourney.body: The app observes the machine, prepares a plan you can review, and keeps the comparison tied to the real conditions of your own session.

conversionJourney.label: Competitive Mode
conversionJourney.title: Prepare Windows for the match — and bring everything back when it ends.
conversionJourney.body: Competitive Mode calibrates preparation for your hardware and each game. It focuses the session on what matters, reduces known interference, and preserves the previous state for restoration.
points: Before the match, review the calibration and proposed changes for that game.
During the session, the profile focuses resources without promising a result that has not been measured.
When you finish, the app restores temporary actions and keeps the history available.

conversionJourney.label: Results you can inspect
conversionJourney.title: Evidence starts on the same PC, in the same game, under visible conditions.
conversionJourney.body: Measurements stay separate from estimates and unavailable data. Version, scenario, and collection quality travel with the comparison so you can see what was observed and what remains unproven.

conversionJourney.label: Free or Premium
conversionJourney.title: Start with the essentials. Advance when per-game automation makes sense.
conversionJourney.body: Essential Mode is free forever and keeps diagnostics, manual application, one active profile, history, and restoration. Premium adds calibration, unlimited profiles, automatic activation, and advanced comparisons.

conversionJourney.label: Safety and restoration
conversionJourney.title: Performance also means having a clear path back.
conversionJourney.body: Every reviewed change leaves a record. History and restoration stay available on Free and Premium, including after a subscription ends.

conversionJourney.label: Before you install
conversionJourney.title: Direct answers so you can decide with confidence.
conversionJourney.body: See how Free works, where analysis happens, what can be undone, and why no result is promised before local measurement.

conversionJourney.label: Free · Essential Mode
conversionJourney.title: Your first result starts on your own PC.
conversionJourney.body: Download the app, confirm compatibility, and start with Essential Mode. Distribution remains blocked until version, signature, integrity, and compatibility are approved.

faq.question: Is Free a trial?
faq.answer: No. Essential Mode is free forever, with no card, ads, or daily limits.

faq.question: Does the app guarantee more FPS?
faq.answer: No. Liiiraa Boost measures your PC and reports only comparable results under recorded conditions.

faq.question: Can I undo an adjustment?
faq.answer: Yes. History and restoration remain available on Free and Premium.

faq.question: Where is the PC analyzed?
faq.answer: In the Windows desktop app. The website never performs deep machine analysis.

hero.promise: Prepare your PC. Prove the result. Restore with control.
hero.summary: Analyze your PC, apply only what makes sense, and compare the session knowing that every change can be restored.

trustBoundary.title: The product you will use
trustBoundary.body: This is a real capture of the desktop application. Performance results appear only after analysis and measurement on your own PC.

chapters.title: Prepare with a plan you can review
chapters.summary: The app considers hardware, Windows, drivers, processes, and games before recommending any adjustment.
chapters.claim: You receive a reviewable plan with impact, risk, and dependencies visible before application.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The review experience is available; performance gains depend on measurement on your own PC.

chapters.title: Prove without turning a hypothesis into a result
chapters.summary: Before and after use the same PC and keep the game, version, conditions, and data source visible.
chapters.claim: Measurements, estimates, and unavailable data are separated to prevent misleading conclusions.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: No performance number is claimed before local analysis and benchmarking.

chapters.title: Restore with the same rigor used to prepare
chapters.summary: History, consequences, and recovery remain visible on every plan.
chapters.claim: You can identify what changed and start restoration without depending on an active subscription.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: Restoration depends on a valid recovery point and never bypasses a safety failure.

chapters.title: Compatibility is a decision, not a generic badge
chapters.summary: Windows 10 and 11 define the platform boundary. CPU, GPU, storage, network, and game profile still need to be observed.
chapters.claim: The public journey blocks universal conclusions and routes every visitor to a compatibility check.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The target platform is defined; support for a specific configuration is not claimed without validated inventory.

chapters.title: Control begins with decisions that can be audited
chapters.summary: Every change has a purpose, consequence, validation, and a path back.
chapters.claim: Liiiraa Boost runs only known operations and refuses arbitrary remote commands.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: An operation is offered only when compatibility, permission, and recovery can be verified.

chapters.title: A release counts only when the whole chain agrees
chapters.summary: Manifest, notes, compatibility, signature, and artifact must form a verifiable story before distribution.
chapters.claim: Public distribution remains blocked while no publicly trusted installer has been approved.
chapters.unprovenBoundary: The current gate is verifiable; no release date, SmartScreen reputation, or future availability is promised.
